dct_description_sm: These files contain raw data for multiple bioacoustic sound indices (BCI, ACI, ADI, NDSI), as well as changes in estimated field yields and profits following an experiment on 50 fields in Saskatchewan, Canada.  The study was comparing treatment fields relative to business as usual (reference) fields after conversion of marginal patches of cropland into perennial forages and tracking responses over a 2-3 year period (2019-2022). These data are associated with the article, "Increased Avian Bioacoustic Diversity without Lost Profit after Planting Perennial Vegetation in Marginal Cropland" by Mitchell et al. (2025).
